trait.name: Holy Law Above All
base: The character's [Piety] cannot increase or decrease. Increases final DMG by 25% and reduces final DMG taken by 25%.

Has the skill [Holy Law Decree] to set holy laws. When other characters in battle (allies or enemies) break them, [Holy Law Violation] triggers and their [Piety] decreases by 15. Can be triggered up to 1 time per character per round (this effect does not make enemies engage or seek targets).
At the start of the first battle round, triggers [Preemptive Action], which can only cast [Holy Law Decree].

1: All enemies in battle with [Piety]<0 have their ATK and DEF stats reduced by 8%.
2: All enemies in battle with [Piety]<0 have their ATK and DEF stats reduced by 8%.
When [Holy Law Violation] triggers, the [Piety] decrease rises to 20.
3: All enemies in battle with [Piety]<0 have their ATK and DEF stats reduced by 12%; when their [Piety] is -50 or lower, their ATK and DEF stats are further reduced in combat by 5% of [Cassandra]'s M.ATK.
When [Holy Law Violation] triggers, the [Piety] decrease rises to 20.
4: All enemies in battle with [Piety]<0 have their ATK and DEF stats reduced by 12%; when their [Piety] is -50 or lower, their ATK and DEF stats are further reduced in combat by 5% of [Cassandra]'s M.ATK.
When [Holy Law Violation] triggers, the [Piety] decrease rises to 25.
5: All enemies in battle with [Piety]<0 have their ATK and DEF stats reduced by 15%; when their [Piety] is -50 or lower, their ATK and DEF stats are further reduced in combat by 10% of [Cassandra]'s M.ATK.
When [Holy Law Violation] triggers, the [Piety] decrease rises to 25.

23378.name: Guilty Verdict
desc: (Piercing DMG) [Instant] Can only target enemies with [Piety]<0. Deals Piercing DMG equal to (80% + 3% × negative [Piety] points) of M.ATK (up to 260%). Before attacking, inflicts [Isolate], [Shackle], [⊘Reaction Skills] and [⊘Passive Skills] for 2 turns.

23351.name: Radiance of Retribution
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 60% of M.ATK, recovers 1 NRG and inflicts [Mark of Sin] (2 turns).

23467.name: Disarming Strike - Piercing
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 60% of M.ATK and inflicts [▼ATK I] on the target for 2 turns.

23365.name: Harsh Penalties
desc: (Passive) When any character triggers [Holy Law Violation] and their [Piety] decreases, it decreases by an additional 5.
Also has an aura affecting all enemies in battle:
While [Piety]<0, they suffer [▼ATK II], [▼P.DEF II] and [▼M.DEF II].
While [Piety] is -50 or lower, their final DMG is reduced by 10% and final DMG taken increases by 10%.

23366.name: Reward of Order
desc: (Aura) All allies within 4 tiles of the character who did not trigger [Holy Law Violation] during their current action gain 10 [Piety] at the end of the action, recover 40% HP, and gain [DMG Reduction II] and all [Level 2 DMG Buff] for 1 turn.

23367.name: Majesty of the Codex
desc: (Reaction) After each character's first attack, their [Piety] decreases by 5 (once per character per battle); this can be offset by the trait's [Holy Law Exemption].
When attacked by an enemy with [Piety]<0, reduces DMG taken by 30%.

23353.name: Holy Admonition
desc: (Debuff) Selects a tile and inflicts [Mark of Sin], [Vulnerable II], [Piercing Vulnerable II] and all [Level 2 DMG Debuff] on all enemies within 2 tiles of the target for 3 turns.

23384.name: Weighing the Sins of the World
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects 1 tile in a cross around the character, takes the enemies with [Piety]<0 in the 3×3 areas on both sides and compares their total [Piety] points:
Enemies on the side with more points are knocked back 2 tiles away from the center line; if their [Piety]<0, they also suffer [Penitence].
Enemies on the side with fewer points are knocked back 2 tiles toward the center line (without crossing it).
This skill triggers the [Guilty Verdict] effect on enemies in range with [Piety]<0.

d: (Decision) Selects a skill to decree the matching holy law: [Melee Forbidden], [Ranged Forbidden], [Mercy Forbidden] or [Idleness Forbidden], lasting until the end of battle.
Casting a skill of this series again removes the previous effect.
Special trigger: activates when breaking a holy law decreed by [Cassandra], decreasing [Piety] by a set amount.
[Cassandra] has [Holy Law Exemption]: before an ally in battle triggers [Holy Law Violation], their [Piety] first increases by a set amount to offset it.
Speed increased by 1000, but can only perform specific actions.
After acting, this effect is removed and the holder returns to normal actions and speed.
When [Holy Law Violation] triggers, the [Piety] decrease is doubled.
Overcome with remorse: on its next active attack, shares 35% of the DMG taken by the target (each share cannot exceed the target's max HP).

(Piercing DMG) [Instant] Can only target enemies with [Piety]<0. Deals Piercing DMG equal to (80% + 3% × negative [Piety] points) of M.ATK (up to 260%). Before attacking, inflicts [Isolate], [Shackle], [⊘Reaction Skills] and [⊘Passive Skills] for 2 turns.
